name: automation-platform-backend
description: All Automation Platform services (SprintGuard, load testing, API testing, Rewind, UI Automation controller) with one set of Node dependencies.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev" "cd ../frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:sprintguard: cd .. && cross-env API_HOST=127.0.0.1 API_PORT=8000 python -m uvicorn backend.sprintguard.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend/sprintguard
scripts.dev:load-testing: cd .. && cross-env PYTHONPATH=backend/load-testing/src python -m uvicorn lt.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload --reload-dir backend/load-testing/src
scripts.dev:api-testing: cd .. && cross-env PYTHONPATH=backend/api-testing APIT_PORT=8002 python -m uvicorn apitest.main:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 --reload --reload-dir backend/api-testing/apitest
scripts.dev:ui-automation: cd .. && cross-env PYTHONPATH=backend/ui-automation BASE_URL=http://localhost:8003 DASHBOARD_URL=http://localhost:5174 python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8003 --reload --reload-dir backend/ui-automation/app
scripts.setup: npm install && playwright install chromium && npm run setup:python
scripts.setup:python: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r api-testing/requirements.txt -r ui-automation/requirements.txt -e "load-testing[dev]" && python -m playwright install chromium
